items.title: Stock Futures Rise as Oil Prices Dip After AI Selloff
items.summary: Stocks looked set to struggle for direction on Friday as a drop in oil prices eased fears about higher inflation, even as artificial-intelligence jitters lingered.  Nasdaq 100 futures rose 0.1%.  The Dow was on track to outperform the other two major indexes because it tends to be more reactive to oil prices, which were retreating having spiked above $100 a barrel the previous session.
